text:
alex: FYI planning to be in Berlin for ~12 weeks to support a family situation (May 10 - Aug 2). I'll be fully remote while there. Quick: does WFH stipend continue? Any payroll/tax paperwork I should file before I leave? Concerned about social security and healthcare while abroad.
rachel: Sorry to hear that, hope all ok. Please submit the Temporary Remote form (https://intra.redwood/work-requests/temporary-remote) and add the travel dates to Homebase. Do NOT change your legal home base. We'll route to payroll/tax/legal to confirm.
alex: Thanks : will do. If it's 12 weeks (~84 days) is that an issue for German tax/residency rules?
oliver: Legal here : Germany generally looks at 183 days for tax residency, so 84 days shouldn't by itself create residency. However, local facts matter (rent, family ties, working for a local org). Also Schengen entry for US passport holders covers short stays; no special visa needed for ~12 weeks if within allowed stay.
tomas: Payroll: if you remain on US payroll for the period we'll annotate your record. Stipend: default $120/month, pro-rated by days present in each calendar month. Attach exact dates to the form so payroll can compute the split.
maria: Tax: Germany has specific social security rules; if you stay temporarily and stay on US payroll, SS usually remains US (unless you are seconded or employer registers locally). We'll need your dates and whether you'll have any local contracts or income. Also tell us if you'll rent a place long-term vs Airbnb (housing facts can change assessments).
alex: Health insurance : will my US plan still cover me while I'm in Berlin?
benefits-bot: Benefits note: short foreign travel retains coverage for emergencies; submitted pre-authorization may be required for non-emergency care. See Benefits Abroad page: https://intra.redwood/benefits/faq#abroad. For extended stays consider travel insurance for outpatient care.
alex: OK thanks everyone. Any paperwork re: payroll withholding or bank changes? I don't want to switch accounts.
tomas: Don't open local payroll or company bank accounts. We'll keep US withholding unless tax clears otherwise. You might need to sign an acknowledgement that you remain on US payroll for the period.
rachel: Also add manager approval to the Temp Remote form so the workflow moves faster. If there's any doubt about nexus after we review, Tax will follow up with you within 2 business days.
alex: Submitted the form and attached dates + manager note at 1800105603.
payroll-bot: Temporary remote request received for alex on 1800105603. Payroll & Tax teams noted. (automated message)
oliver: One more operational tip: keep company laptop encrypted, use company VPN, avoid local freelance work, and don't sign local contracts.
alex: Will do. Thanks all 60a
